text_blocks.snippet: An ISOFIX dog car seat or tether uses your vehicle's built-in child safety anchor points (ISOFIX or LATCH system) to lock your pet's bed, booster seat, or restraint directly into the car frame.
snippet_highlighted_words: uses your vehicle's built-in child safety anchor points (ISOFIX or LATCH system) to lock your pet's bed, booster seat, or restraint directly into the car frame

list.snippet: Direct Anchoring: Instead of relying solely on the vehicle's standard seatbelt, the seat or tether clicks straight into the metal ISOFIX/LATCH bars hidden between the rear seat cushions.
Stability: It prevents the dog bed or booster from sliding, tipping, or shifting during sharp turns or sudden stops.
Movement Control: It limits your dog to a designated seating area while still letting them sit, lie down, or look out the window safely.
EzyDog Click ISOFIX Standard / Cargo: Snaps straight into the ISOFIX socket and clips to your dog's harness (around $20–$30 depending on the retailer).
Portable ISOFIX Dog Beds & Booster Seats:
FunnyFuzzy ISOFIX / LATCH Dog Car Seat Beds: Cushioned, machine-washable beds with integrated anchor straps ($68 – $90).
Elevated ISOFIX Booster Seats: Sturdy frames with triple-fixation (ISOFIX belt + headrest straps + leash), such as models available on Amazon (~$50–$80).
Tavo Hendrick Pet Car Seat & Flexible CarrierGo to product viewer dialog for this item.: UN-ECE R129 crash-tested unit with integrated ISOFIX locks, available via Chewy (~$350).

references.title: Tavo Hendrick Pet Car Seat & Flexible Carrier
references.snippet: Crash-tested ISOFIX car seat and flexible transport box The Tavo Hendrick is a crash-tested car seat that also serves as a flexible transport box for small to medium-sized pets. With integrated ISOFIX anchors, it can be directly attached to the vehicle seat – without the need for a separate base station. Ideal for safe, comfortable travel with your dog or cat. Product Description The Hendrick combines safety, spaciousness, and comfort in a well-thought-out design. The integrated ISOFIX locks can be extended and securely fastened with the push of a button. A lever easily releases them – perfect for quick transitions. The all-around mesh provides air circulation and a view. The stable floor structure prevents sagging, and the two washable mattresses offer comfort and hygiene. UPF 50+ fabrics, magnetic doors, and vegan leather details complete the high-quality appearance. Features of Tavo Hendrick * Crash-tested according to UN-ECE R129 standards.
